label: Amazon Basin
note: Deforestation-driven fire regime: dry-season (Aug-Oct) ignition front along the agricultural frontier; large, hot, day-dominant detections.

label: California / US West
note: Mediterranean + forest regime: summer-autumn wind- and drought-driven fires, high intensity, strong interannual swings.

label: Boreal Canada
note: Boreal crown-fire regime: short intense Jun-Aug window, episodic megayears (2023), high night fraction from large smoldering fronts.

label: Eastern Siberia
note: Boreal/permafrost regime: Jul-Aug peak, huge interannual variability, deep smoldering peat fires burn day and night.

label: Congo Basin
note: Savanna-agricultural regime: very frequent, low-intensity burns tightly locked to the dry seasons; the most regular signal on Earth.

label: Borneo & Sumatra
note: Peatland regime: rare but catastrophic El Niño megafires (2015, 2019, 2023); smoldering underground peat produces high night fraction.

label: Australia
note: Arid/shrubland regime: broad austral-summer peak (Nov-Feb), moderate intensity, fire-following-rain variability.

label: Mediterranean Basin
note: European temperate regime: Jul-Aug heatwave-driven fires, high intensity per pixel, low night fraction.
